definitions.explanation: A short comic skit performed by one or more comedians in character, typically with a clear setting (school, office, restaurant) and a punchline. Distinguished from {漫才|まんざい}, which is performed by stand-up duos as themselves.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧コント⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}かった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コント⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧な⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧だ。
examples.english: They are comedians who specialize in sketch comedy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧コント⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台本|だいほん}→台本：11868_daihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I'm writing scripts for new comedy sketches for the program.

notes:
From French {conte} (short tale). On Japanese TV, comedy duos and groups regularly perform brief scripted コント of one to several minutes, often distinguishable by simple costumes and a single set.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コント⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a sketch
- コント⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to perform a sketch
- コント⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧: sketch-comedy show
- コント{師|し}: sketch comedian (less common; usually just ⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧: stand-up comedy duo — two performers as themselves, fast-paced verbal back-and-forth
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧: rakugo — solo seated storytelling in kimono; much longer than コント
